title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 275 Day Transportation Agreement with Bardon Trimount d/b/a Aggregate Industries (Saugus).
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Transportation Agreement. The Department finds the the pricing terms under the Transportation Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclousure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Pual B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-24)
